statement: Source timing audit finds that existing probe context_ns plus RunReport.wall_seconds excludes part of scope-exit teardown: RunReport wall is read before local factor-base/matrix drop, and the boxed oracle is dropped after probe serialization. RhoResult.wall_ns is also read before its local DP/jump-table teardown. Earlier raw plots labelled complete cold therefore cover a narrower recorded computation window; complete cold and primary online timing are not established by those fields. Preserve all frozen results and fix explicit timing windows before a fresh comparison. Whole-guest Callgrind Ir includes process teardown and is unaffected. Unsigned source audit.
